title: Session 2026-11-02, six more data satellites, money-site links, paid rail staged
verdict: Every channel still shows zero verified human usage and $0 MCP revenue, so this session did not add another back-office server. It shipped nine more free servers that know what a model cannot (2026 IRS limits, live certificate data, exact statistics, USDA nutrition, AP score tables, 2027 Social Security and retirement limits, the new student loan plan, the 2026 ACA subsidy cliff), each feeding a money site that already earns. It also linked nine money sites back to their servers, cross-linked all 18 repos, opened three domain-list PRs and staged a real paid rail (Apify pay-per-event) that needs only the owner's token.

shipped.title: student-loan-repayment-assistance-plan-calculator-mcp live
shipped.detail: 4 tools. The Repayment Assistance Plan from P.L. 119-21 (1 to 10% of AGI, $10 minimum, $50 per dependent, interest waiver, $50 principal match, 360 payments), the new PLUS limits and SAVE transition dates, copied from the enrolled law text. 21 fixtures. Spot check AGI $50,000 gives $166.67 a month, matching the statute. Links to mcpstamp.com because no owner site covers student loans.

shipped.title: aca-premium-tax-credit-calculator-mcp live, feeds https://taxbreakcalc.com
shipped.detail: 4 tools. The enhanced credits ended after 2025 (checked against the IRS Q&A and every public law through P.L. 119-136), so the 400% poverty-line cliff applies in 2026. Rev. Proc. 2025-25 table, HHS poverty lines 2024-2026, repayment caps repealed from 2026. 19 fixtures. Spot check 2025 coverage, 1 person, $15,060, correct.
